aboutTagline: Time tracking and project management for freelancers and creative studios.
helpSectionWhatsNewBody: Paused timers crossing midnight save yesterday at 24:00 and show an end-of-day dialog to start today or dismiss. Automatic backups appear in Settings → Restore with clear labels. Quitting with an open timer (including paused) always shows the save dialog.
helpSectionOverviewBody: Dashboard with metrics, deadlines, recent activity, and quick access to the timer and reports.
helpSectionClientsBody: Add and manage clients with contact details, hourly rates, and currencies. Archive or favorite clients for quick access.
helpSectionProjectsBody: Create projects linked to clients. Track status, deadlines, and progress. Open project detail for tasks and time summary.
helpSectionBoardBody: Kanban board with drag-and-drop tasks across columns. Link work to projects and priorities.
helpSectionTimerBody: Start, Pause, and Stop control live time tracking. Stop saves a session; Pause records break time. Sessions crossing midnight split automatically at 24:00.
helpSectionSessionsBody: View, filter, and edit all time sessions. Set an hourly rate per session and add manual entries. Overnight manual entries (end before start) save as two sessions.
helpSectionReportsBody: Generate Time & Billing reports with filters. Export PDF or Excel. On macOS, Send Report opens Mail with the attachment — nothing is sent until you confirm in Mail.
helpSectionSettingsBody: Studio profile, logo, language, default rate, and data tools.
helpSectionMiniTimerBody: Compact always-on-top window synced with the main app. On macOS, red closes (save dialog when active), yellow switches to compact size, green restores default size.
helpSectionBackupBody: Create a named manual backup anytime, or automatic archives before clean operations. Automatic backups appear in the restore list. Restore from archive or refresh from the local database.
helpSectionLocalDataBody: All data is stored locally in SQLite on your device. No cloud account is required.
privacyBody:
Musomo Tracker does not use cloud accounts, analytics, or telemetry. The app does not automatically send your data to Musomo.

Clients, projects, tasks, and time sessions are stored in a local SQLite database. Studio logos, avatars, and backups are stored locally on your device.

PDF and Excel exports are saved to your Downloads folder. Send Report on macOS opens your local Mail app with an attachment — no email is sent automatically.

You are responsible for the personal data you enter about your clients.

More information: https://tracker.musomo.net/
